# aibris v0.16.0

This minor release explains a Go build cache that aibris will not clean
instead of leaving it out silently. It adds one scan row type and one plan
reason code; deletion behavior is unchanged.

## Highlights

- **A Go cache that fails verification is shown, with the reason** (#619).
  - aibris removes a Go build cache only when every top-level entry is one Go
    creates. Before, a cache with anything else at the top level (a stray
    file, a symlink, a wrong file type) or an unreadable layout disappeared
    from `scan` and `clean --dry-run` without explanation.
  - It now appears with its measured size and the cause, for example
    `held back  195.4 KB  Go cache unverified: foreign entry "notes.txt"`.
    Remove the foreign entry and the next scan treats it as a normal cache.
  - `clean --dry-run --json` marks it `skipped` with reason code
    `go_cache_unverified` and leaves its bytes out of `selected_bytes`. Scan
    totals include the bytes.
  - A `GOCACHE` override (from the environment or the `GOENV` file) without
    Go's README signature stays hidden, because nothing shows it is a Go
    cache.

## Compatibility impact

- [x] **Compatible addition.**
  - New reason code `go_cache_unverified` in clean plans, and a `go-build`
    scan item with a human `reason` for a cache rejected by its layout.
  - Agents that drive the CLI may see a new skipped row in plans. No flag,
    field, or enum value was removed or renamed, and `schema_version` stays
    `1`.

## Upgrade and migration

No flag migration is required.

```bash
brew upgrade aibris
# or (Unix):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.sh | bash -s -- v0.16.0
# or (Windows PowerShell):
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

- The last-scan cache changed revision. A snapshot from an earlier version is
  discarded and the next command rescans.

## Safety

- Every earlier safeguard is unchanged: the single deletion gate, dry-run and
  confirmation, `--risky`, active-worktree protection, agent-state proof and
  grace, re-verification at the mutation boundary, and overlap safety.
- The new row never makes a cache removable. Eligibility is re-derived from
  the live cache catalog (path, signature, layout) before age or pressure
  rules, so neither a cached scan row nor `--force`, a minimal `--age`, or
  volume-pressure relaxation can select an unverified Go cache. The layout is
  checked again right before any removal.
- When another catalog entry independently selects the same directory (for
  example, `GOCACHE` pointed at another tool's cache), that entry's existing
  decision and byte accounting apply, as before.
- A valid Go cache is still removed as a whole directory.

## Windows status

Unchanged from v0.15.2. Native Windows CI runs the restored cleaner command
tests, the cache-leaf, `sessions/`, and Codex home junction tests, the full
`internal/safedelete`, `internal/pathidentity`, and `internal/testutil`
packages, and the production PowerShell installer tests. Real vendor agent
worktree layouts on Windows, end-to-end delete mutation, and native arm64
execution remain experimental and unmeasured. See `docs/WINDOWS.md`.
